flows:
Navigate to https://www.fourmilab.ch/cgi-bin/Earth then Work exclusively inside the Reading view dialog.
Use only its listed roles, names and controls.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
In Reading view, first assert that the exact row ‘textbox · Latitude’ is present.
Set that textbox to 10 and press Tab to commit the change.
Verify its value is 10 and the ‘radio · Lat: · checked’ row confirms custom latitude mode.
Stop at that selection without using Update.
